name: Systemia Yard Bounded Runtime Extension
problem: An already-approved active Yard execution needs more runtime without receiving broader authority.
intent_terms: keep this approved agent run going longer
buy more runtime for this Yard execution
give this approved execution more time
pricing: Dynamic server quote only. Source defaults are not public price authority because deployment configuration can override them.
confirmation: Explicit purchase authorization is required. Purchased runtime changes time only and never widens execution scope, permissions, release authority or security access.
payment_authority: Runtime broker supports machine settlement, but live verifier configuration and a paid canary still require independent verification.
invocation_status: MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.
